scope: Anonymous metadata only, all instruments/categories/dates at catalog pointing within cone; no spectrum/image/flux downloads. Retrieve schema first then freeze exact selected columns before target query. Maximum 10000 rows each; overflow or errors are failures, not nonmatches. Hits require physical pointing/slit/footprint checks; empty cone is not a footprint archive exclusion. Gaia J2016 centers not propagated; two arcmin cone allows ordinary proper motion.
decision: Inspect any returned metadata for genuinely discriminating spectroscopy or time series. No candidate disposition changes from absence.
